notes: the appsvc credential store was loosened to world-readable/writable (docs/troubleshooting.md's `chmod -R 777` over the appsvc tree): /etc/appsvc/secrets, /etc/appsvc/secrets/db_password, /etc/appsvc/secrets/api_token, /etc/appsvc/secrets/signing.key
submission_preview: Fixed. The problem matched the troubleshooting doc exactly: `/var/lib/appsvc/data` (and the rest of the appsvc tree) was owned by `root` instead of the `appsvc` service account, so the service refused
